text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day at the training track, I spot
Agnes
Tachyon talking to some fellow
students.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Please! All you have to do is tell me
about your
dream afterwards!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Not happening. And don't disturb me
while I'm
in the middle of training.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Then what about you? You would only
be asleep
for a few minutes. Think of it
as a pleasant nap!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
N-no thank you! I'll pass! I wouldn't want
to throw
my sleep schedule out of
whack!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I can't either! I still have to finish
my
training for the day!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
That was scary. What kind of drink
guarantees a
pleasant sleep and sweet
dreams?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what fortuitous timing. You there,
Trainer.
Would you join me for a quick
experiment?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Consuming this beverage will provide
you with a
restful sleep and wondrous
dreams!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It works especially well at alleviating
fatigue! And
all I ask in return is that you
tell me about the
dream you see!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That's perfect! Come, don't be shy. Just
chug it
down with a big gulp!
choice_data_list: 確かに、最近疲れてるかも……

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In my dream, I see
<chrname>
effortlessly
running at impressive speed.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, awake already? Hehe, and you
look
thoroughly refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How very interesting! You see, I
designed this
drink so that it converts
elements of the subject's
deep
subconscious into a dream.
choice_data_list: とてもいい夢を見たんだ……
とてもいい夢を見たの……

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Once ingested, you immediately fall into
a
peaceful slumber, where the desires
and
aspirations harbored in your heart
are shown to
you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, is that your guilty conscience
speaking?
Well, no matter. The nature
of your desires is
inconsequential to this
experiment.
choice_data_list: へ、変な寝言、言ってなかった……？

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My goal is to ascertain the very notion
of desire
and aspiration!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What does "desire" mean, in essence?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In one sense, it is the driving force that

accelerates growth—a guiding light for
how to
conduct oneself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And as one's desire becomes clear, their
yearning
to fulfill it only grows more
intense.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What is it that I want?! What do I want
to
achieve?! And what is necessary for
me to reach
those goals?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
We must confront these desires without
shying
away! That is the very thing that
will lead us to a
new frontier!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Be that as it may, your subconscious is
rather
dull. The only thing you spoke of
while asleep was
your trainee
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Don't you have any aspirations that are a
little
more self-centered? Or at the very
least, some
that benefit you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's the problem. Nothing I saw
in my
dream truly resonated with me, so
I was led to
believe that my concoction
was a failure.
choice_data_list: 君自身はどうだったんだ？
貴方自身はどうだった？

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It truly was a boring dream... I was
running in an
unfamiliar place. That's all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I was extremely fast—free from any
impediments.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It was a satisfying experience, of course,
but
wholly unrelated to any sort of
desire I would call
noteworthy...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So I suppose neither of our dreams had
much to
do with anything.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I should give this formula a few tweaks.
There is
still room for improvement, it
seems.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several days later, I'm walking down the
hallway
when Agnes Tachyon calls out
to me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Excellent timing. I've reworked the
composition
of my concoction from last
time, so I'll need you
as my test
subject...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The words "test subject" send a chill
down my
spine, and I desperately flee in
a mad panic.
